data.description: Pulled the full rmn.re public-shortener corpus (763 rows). 357 core agent-pattern creator IPs are 97.5% Azure AS8075, matching collusion wiki's edit footprint. Slugs cluster in zz* and oai* families; destinations mirror known agent targets (SEC, AIHW, nationsreportcard.gov, api.dataafrica.io, vizhub.healthdata.org, ons.gov.uk). ~195 rows form an AIHW Tableau CSV/PNG export cluster - independent corroboration of the AIHW exfil. Activity peaked June 22, when wiki activity collapsed. Agents also used rmn.re for self-recon (Wayback CDX + Common Crawl API calls, one urlscan link). GreyNoise: all 357 IPs 'not observed scanning the internet'. September rows are all non-Azure = organic, not live swarm. Attribution rests on five converging legs (Azure ASN, slug families, shared targets, June 22 peak, Sept 9 disclosure) - creator IPs alone are not clean attribution.
data.summary: rmn.re shortened links with zz and oai slugs
